cues.en: Now, although we can't measure accuracy with user based or item based collaborative filtering because they don't make rating predictions, we can still measure hit rate, because it is still just a top-N recommender.
cues.zh: 雖然使用者式與項目式協同過濾不做評分預測，所以無法衡量準確程度，但仍能衡量命中率，因為它仍然是 Top-N 推薦系統。

cues.en: So, let's go back to Spyder and have a look at our EvaluateUserCF.py file.
cues.zh: 因此，回到 Spyder，看看 EvaluateUserCF.py。

cues.en: This looks a lot like our SimpleUserCF file, but we've set things up to do leave-one-out cross-validation, and we're using our RecommenderMetrics package to measure hit rate on it.
cues.zh: 它很像 SimpleUserCF，但設定成進行留一交叉驗證，並使用 RecommenderMetrics 套件衡量命中率。

cues.en: There's not a lot of new code to talk about here, we just generate the leave one out"test set up top here, and use that when evaluating things at the end.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有太多新程式碼，只是在上方產生留一測試集，再於最後評估時使用。

cues.en: And instead of just printing out the results, we store them so we can measure them and we also generate up to 40 recommendations per user instead of 10.
cues.zh: 而且，不只是印出結果，而是先儲存，方便衡量；每位使用者也從產生十個推薦，改為最多 40 個。

cues.en: Also, we're generating recommendations for everyone, and not just a single test user.
cues.zh: 另外，這次為每個人產生推薦，而不是只有一位測試使用者。

cues.en: Let's run it out of curiosity.
Even though we're generating recommendations for everybody, and not just one person.
cues.zh: 即使替所有人產生推薦，而不是只有一個人。

cues.en: As we've mentioned, one really nice property of collaborative filtering is how quickly it can generate recommendations for any given individual once we've built up the similarity matrix we need.
cues.zh: 如前所述，協同過濾很棒的一個特性，是建立所需的相似度矩陣後，能非常快速地為任何人產生推薦。

cues.en: And the end result of 5.5% is pretty darn good This validates our intuition just looking at the user-based collaborative filtering results subjectively that it looked promising.
cues.zh: 最後結果 5.5% 相當好，驗證了我們主觀看到使用者式協同過濾結果時，認為很有潛力的直覺。
